pooled_vs_fold_reconciliation.rule: a pooled pass is NEVER reported as a pass while a term is absent in a fold unless every affected fold carries an explicit verdict -- UNEVALUABLE, or ESTIMABLE_UNDER_PREREGISTERED_ACTIVE_SET with the drop recorded. GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT sections 1 and 4

seeds.derivation: seed(purpose, fold_id, b) = first 4 bytes of sha256(utf8('{master_seed}|{fold_id}|{purpose}|{b}')) as big-endian unsigned int
seeds.fitting: IRLS is deterministic; no fit-time seed exists
